title: TERMINATOR: Learning Optimal Exit Points for Early Stopping in Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2603.12529v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve impressive performance on complex reasoning tasks via Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, which enables them to generate intermediate thinking tokens before arriving at the final answer. However, LRMs often suffer from significant overthinking, spending excessive compute time even after the answer is generated early on. Prior work has identified the existence of an optimal reasoning length such that truncating reasoning at this point significantly shortens CoT outputs with virtually no change in performance. However, determining optimal CoT lengths for practical datasets is highly non-trivial as they are fully task and model-dependent. In this paper, we precisely address this and design Terminator, an early-exit strategy for LRMs at inference to mitigate overthinking. translated_title: TERMINATOR：为思维链推理中的早停学习最优退出点
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型通过思维链推理在复杂推理任务上取得了令人瞩目的性能，这使其能够在得出最终答案之前生成中间思考标记。然而，大型推理模型常常存在显著的过度思考问题——即使答案早已生成，它们仍会花费过多的计算时间。先前的研究已经发现最优推理长度的存在，在该点截断推理可以显著缩短CoT输出，而性能几乎没有任何变化。然而，为实际数据集确定最优CoT长度绝非易事，因为它完全依赖于具体任务和模型。在本文中，我们精确地解决了这一问题，并设计了Terminator，一种针对大型推理模型的推理时提前退出策略，用以缓解过度思考。支撑Terminator的核心思想是：大型推理模型最终答案的首次出现往往是可预测的，我们利用……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 提出了Terminator，一种针对大型推理模型的推理时提前退出策略，通过预测最终答案首次出现的位置来学习最优退出点，从而在几乎不损失性能的前提下缓解思维链推理中的过度思考并大幅降低计算开销。
en_tdlr: Terminator is an inference-time early-exit strategy for Large Reasoning Models that learns optimal exit points by predicting the first arrival of the final answer, mitigating overthinking in Chain-of-Thought reasoning with virtually no performance loss.
